Zhiheng; Wang, Alex Jinpeng; Tang, Jing; Li, Min（单位未提供） 期刊/预印本平台 : Advanced Science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany) 年份 : 2026-09-11 论文类型 : 研究论文 领域 : 药物-靶标相互作用预测、分子生成设计、AI方法 关键词 : 未提供 DOI/arXiv 号 : 10.1002/advs.77238 代码 : 未提供 数据 : 未提供 阅读日期 : 2025-04-05 该文在「无序蛋白/相分离 × 蛋白互作 × AI 方法」方向中的位置 : 本文提出了一种位点感知的表示学习框架MolDBG，统一了亲和力预测、结合位点识别和条件分子生成。其关键贡献在于显式建模结合位点（binding site），并声称能泛化到结构难以捉摸的靶标，包括 内在无序蛋白（IDPs） 。这为IDP/IDR介导的蛋白互作研究提供了一种无需高分辨率结构、仅依赖序列信息即可进行位点特异性建模和分子设计的AI方法，直接关联本课题方向。 02 一句话总结 本文提出MolDBG框架，通过结合位点监督（binding-site supervision）优先学习关键残基的表示，统一了药物-靶标亲和力预测、结合位点识别和条件分子生成三个任务，并声称能泛化到包括内在无序蛋白在内的结构动态靶标。 03 研究问题 具体问题 : 如何在一个统一的、可解释的框架中，同时实现准确的药物-靶标亲和力预测和靶向分子设计，特别是对于结合位点不明确或结构动态的靶标（如IDPs）？ 为什么重要 : 现有方法要么是序列基的（全局表示，缺乏位点特异性，导致假阳性），要么是结构基的（依赖高质量结构，不适用于动态靶标）。统一框架能提升药物筛选和设计的效率与可解释性。 现有方法为何不足 : 序列基方法（如基于CNN/Transformer的亲和力预测）使用全局靶标表示，无法区分哪个区域负责结合，导致位点模糊和假阳性。结构基方法（如对接）需要高分辨率结构，对IDP等动态靶标不适用。 精确的「Can ... ?」研究问题 : Can a single, site-aware framework, trained with binding-site supervision, simultaneously achieve competitive performance in affinity prediction, binding-site identification, and targeted molecular generation, while generalizing to structurally elusive targets like intrinsically disordered proteins? 04 背景与发展脉络 阶段一: 序列基方法 (如DeepDTA, GraphDTA) 代表性方法 : 使用1D序列或2D图表示药物和靶标，通过CNN或Transformer学习全局表示进行亲和力预测。 优点 : 无需蛋白结构，数据易得。 局限 : 缺乏位点特异性，无法区分关键结合区域，可解释性差，易产生假阳性。 阶段二: 结构基方法 (如分子对接, 基于结构的深度学习) 代表性方法 : 使用蛋白3D结构进行对接或基于结构的深度学习预测。 优点 : 物理上更精确，能提供结合模式信息。 局限 : 依赖高质量蛋白结构，对IDP、膜蛋白等动态或难结晶靶标不适用，计算成本高。 本文主张的位置 : MolDBG属于 序列基但位点感知 的方法。它通过引入结合位点监督信号，在序列信息的基础上显式建模关键残基，从而克服了传统序列基方法缺乏位点特异性的缺点，同时避免了结构基方法对高分辨率结构的依赖。它声称能统一多个任务，并泛化到IDP等动态靶标。 脉络来源 : 经外部核验，该脉络是药物-靶标相互作用预测领域的常见分类。 05 核心痛点 痛点 表现 成因或作者解释 文中证据 位点模糊性 序列基方法在亲和力预测和分子设计中，无法确定药物与靶标的哪个区域结合，导致假阳性预测和无效设计。 模型使用全局靶标表示，没有显式学习或利用结合位点信息。 作者在引言中明确指出“Many sequence-based affinity and design methods rely on global target representations without explicitly modeling binding regions, leading to site-level ambiguity”。 对结构动态靶标不适用 结构基方法无法处理IDP、隐式口袋（cryptic pockets）等结构动态或难以解析的靶标。 这些方法需要高质量的静态3D结构作为输入。 作者在摘要和引言中提及“structure-based methods require high-quality structural data and are poorly suited to dynamic targets”，并声称MolDBG能泛化到“structurally elusive targets, including cryptic pockets and intrinsically disordered proteins”。 任务不统一 亲和力预测、结合位点识别和分子设计通常由独立的模型完成，缺乏协同和可解释性。 不同任务的目标和输入输出格式差异大，难以在一个框架内整合。 作者提出MolDBG作为“a unified site-aware framework that combines affinity prediction, binding-site identification, and affinity-conditioned molecular generation within a single architecture”。 06 核心思想 表面方法 : 构建一个名为MolDBG的深度学习框架，该框架包含一个 位点感知编码器（Site-Aware Encoder） ，该编码器在训练时使用结合位点标签进行监督，从而学习优先关注靶标序列中与结合相关的关键残基。然后，基于这些位点感知的表示，框架通过不同的解码器或预测头来执行亲和力预测、结合位点识别和条件分子生成三个任务。 核心洞察 : 显式地将“结合位点”作为先验知识和监督信号引入序列基模型，可以迫使模型学习到更具物理意义和可解释性的表示 。这种表示不仅提升了亲和力预测的准确性（通过减少位点模糊性），还自然地为结合位点识别和靶向分子设计提供了基础。对于IDP等动态靶标，尽管其整体结构不固定，但其与配体相互作用的 关键残基（结合位点） 在序列上可能相对保守或可预测，因此基于序列的位点感知方法可以绕过对静态结构的依赖。 可能的普适教训 [Analysis] : 在生物序列建模中，当全局表示不足以捕捉关键功能区域时，引入 局部功能区域（如结合位点、活性位点、修饰位点）的弱监督或自监督信号 ，可以显著提升模型的可解释性和下游任务性能，尤其适用于结构信息缺失或动态的系统（如IDP/IDR）。这提示我们，对于IDP介导的互作，与其试图预测其整体构象，不如聚焦于预测其 关键的线性基序（SLiMs）或相互作用热点 。 07 方法总览 输入 : 药物分子（SMILES或分子图）、靶标蛋白（氨基酸序列）、（训练时）结合位点标签（二进制掩码，标记哪些残基是结合位点）。 输出 : 亲和力分数（标量）、结合位点概率（每个残基的概率）、新分子（SMILES或分子图）。 模块 : 药物编码器 : 将药物分子编码为向量表示。 靶标编码器 : 将靶标蛋白序列编码为残基级别的表示。 位点感知编码器 : 核心模块。它接收靶标编码器的输出，并结合结合位点监督信号，学习一个注意力机制或门控机制， 优先关注 被标记为结合位点的残基，生成一个加权后的靶标表示。 亲和力预测头 : 将药物表示和位点感知的靶标表示进行交互（如拼接、点积），预测亲和力。 结合位点识别头 : 基于靶标编码器或位点感知编码器的输出，预测每个残基是结合位点的概率。 分子生成器 : 一个条件生成模型（如VAE或GAN），以位点感知的靶标表示和期望的亲和力条件为输入，生成新的药物分子。 训练 : 多任务学习，同时优化亲和力预测损失、结合位点识别损失和分子生成损失。 工具 : 深度学习框架（如PyTorch/TensorFlow），图神经网络（GNN）或Transformer。 反馈回路 : 分子生成器生成的分子可以反馈给亲和力预测头进行虚拟筛选，形成闭环。 假设 : 结合位点标签是准确且可获取的；位点感知的表示能够有效提升所有下游任务的性能；对于IDP，其序列上的结合位点信息足以指导分子设计。 文字流程 : 1. 药物分子和靶标序列分别通过各自的编码器得到初始表示。 2. 靶标序列的残基级表示进入位点感知编码器，该编码器在训练时利用结合位点标签学习一个注意力权重，使得模型更关注结合位点残基，输出一个加权的、位点感知的靶标表示。 3. 药物表示和位点感知的靶标表示被送入亲和力预测头，输出预测的亲和力分数。 4. 靶标序列的残基级表示（或位点感知编码器的中间表示）被送入结合位点识别头，输出每个残基是结合位点的概率。 5. 位点感知的靶标表示和一个目标亲和力值被送入分子生成器，生成一个符合该靶标和亲和力要求的新分子。 08 核心模块拆解 模块 功能 为何需要 输入输出 支撑证据 移除后的已知或预期影响 位点感知编码器 学习一个注意力机制，优先关注结合位点残基，生成位点感知的靶标表示。 解决传统序列基方法缺乏位点特异性的核心痛点，提升可解释性和预测准确性。 输入 : 靶标残基级表示 + 结合位点标签（训练时）。 输出 : 加权的、位点感知的靶标表示。 作者声称该模块是框架的核心，并指出其能“reducing false positives from misaligned binding sites and improving interpretability”。 预期影响 : 模型退化为传统的全局表示模型，亲和力预测的假阳性率可能上升，可解释性下降，分子生成可能失去靶向性。 实测消融效应 : 未提供。 亲和力预测头 基于药物和位点感知的靶标表示，预测结合亲和力。 实现统一框架中的核心任务之一。 输入 : 药物表示 + 位点感知的靶标表示。 输出 : 亲和力分数。 作者声称MolDBG在亲和力预测上达到“competitive performance”。 预期影响 : 无法进行亲和力预测，框架失去筛选功能。 结合位点识别头 预测靶标序列上每个残基是结合位点的概率。 提供可解释性，并验证位点感知编码器学到的知识。 输入 : 靶标残基级表示。 输出 : 每个残基的结合位点概率。 作者声称框架能实现“interpretable binding-site discovery”。 预期影响 : 框架失去位点识别能力，可解释性降低。 分子生成器 根据位点感知的靶标表示和亲和力条件，生成新的药物分子。 实现统一框架中的设计任务，实现从“筛选”到“设计”的闭环。 输入 : 位点感知的靶标表示 + 目标亲和力。 输出 : 新分子。 作者声称框架能实现“affinity-conditioned molecular generation”。 预期影响 : 框架失去分子设计能力。 09 关键公式符号 不适用。提供的材料（摘要）中未包含任何数学公式。 10 实验设计与证据链 数据集/群体 : 未提供。 规模 : 未提供。 指标 : 未提供。 基线 : 未提供。 预算 : 未提供。 骨干/仪器 : 未提供。 Oracle 输入 : 未提供。 评测协议 : 未提供。 实验 检验的claim 对比与条件 结果 支持的结论 不支持更强的结论 来源 本文结论严格限定在药物-靶标相互作用建模和分子设计领域，具体为亲和力预测、结合位点识别和条件分子生成三个任务。 Oracle/真值输入 : 训练过程依赖于 结合位点标签 作为监督信号。这意味着模型的性能上限受限于这些标签的质量和覆盖范围。对于IDP，其结合位点（如SLiMs）的定义和标注可能比结构化蛋白更模糊。 端到端状态 : 框架是端到端训练的，但分子生成模块可能依赖于预训练的生成模型或特定的解码策略。 算力成本 : 未提供。 历史数据依赖 : 模型性能高度依赖于训练数据中药物-靶标对和结合位点标注的分布。对于数据稀疏的靶标（如某些IDP），性能可能下降。 模型依赖 : 结论依赖于MolDBG的具体架构设计（如位点感知编码器的具体实现）。 最难情形 : 对于结合位点高度动态、模糊或由多个远距离残基构成的IDP，模型可能难以准确学习。 群体/领域边界 : 结论主要适用于小分子药物与蛋白靶标的相互作用。对于蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）或核酸-蛋白相互作用，其适用性未知。 不确定性 : 作者声称“competitive performance”和“generalizes to...”，但未提供任何定量数据或统计显著性检验，因此这些结论的强度和边界是高度不确定的。 有边界的复述 : 本文提出的MolDBG框架，在 有结合位点标签监督 的条件下，能够在一个模型中同时完成药物-靶标亲和力预测、结合位点识别和条件分子生成，并在 所测试的数据集上 （未公开）取得了有竞争力的结果。该框架的设计理念使其 理论上 能够应用于IDP等结构动态靶标，但 缺乏在IDP相关数据集上的定量验证 。 12 作者自认局限 在提供的材料（摘要）中未发现作者明确承认的局限。 作者提及的相关约束 : - 作者提到“Many sequence-based affinity and design methods rely on global target representations...”，这间接承认了当前方法的局限性，但未将其作为本文的局限。 - 作者提到“structure-based methods require high-quality structural data and are poorly suited to dynamic targets”，这指出了结构基方法的局限，而非本文的局限。 13 批判性分析 [Analysis] 观察 潜在问题或替代解释 为何重要 如何检验 依据 声称能泛化到IDP，但未提供任何IDP相关的实验证据。 这可能只是一个概念上的声称，实际性能可能很差。IDP的结合位点（SLiMs）通常很短且动态，与结构化蛋白的刚性口袋有本质区别，模型可能无法有效处理。 这是本文对IDP/IDR领域最直接的声称，其真实性直接决定了该工作对本课题的价值。 在公开的IDP-配体相互作用数据集（如DisProt, ELM相关数据）上测试MolDBG的亲和力预测和结合位点识别性能，并与专门为IDP设计的方法（如基于SLiM匹配的方法）进行比较。 摘要中仅提及“generalizes to... intrinsically disordered proteins”，无任何数据支撑。 未提供任何定量结果（指标、基线对比）。 结论“competitive performance”缺乏客观依据，可能是在特定、有利的数据集上取得的结果，或性能远低于SOTA。 科学论文的核心是提供可验证的证据。缺乏定量结果使得本文的结论无法被评估和复现。 要求作者提供详细的实验设置、数据集划分、性能指标（如RMSE, CI, AUC, ROC-AUC等）以及与多个强基线的对比结果。 摘要中完全没有数字、表格或图表引用。 依赖结合位点标签作为监督信号。 获取高质量的结合位点标签成本高昂，且对于许多靶标（尤其是IDP）可能不存在或不可靠。这限制了模型的适用范围。 这是模型的核心假设和输入要求。如果标签难以获取，模型的实际可用性会大打折扣。 测试模型在仅有少量或弱结合位点标签（如从突变扫描或进化信息推断）情况下的性能。探索使用自监督或弱监督方法来减少对精确标签的依赖。 作者在摘要中明确提到“With binding-site supervision”。 统一框架的“统一”程度可能有限。 三个任务可能共享底层编码器，但预测头和生成器可能是独立训练的，或者生成器的性能远低于专用模型。 “统一”是本文的主要卖点之一。如果各任务间没有正向协同，甚至相互干扰，那么统一框架的优势就不复存在。 进行消融实验，比较多任务联合训练与单任务训练的性能差异。评估生成分子的质量是否受益于位点感知的表示。 摘要中仅声称“unified”，未提供任何关于任务间协同作用的分析。 14 学到什么 Agent 提炼的知识候选 概念: 位点感知（Site-Awareness）作为序列基方法的增强策略 可迁移性 : 对于IDP/IDR介导的蛋白互作，我们可以借鉴“位点感知”的思想，但将“结合位点”替换为“ 相互作用基序（SLiMs） ”或“ 相分离驱动区域（如PLDs, RGG boxes） ”。 如何迁移 : 在预测IDP与某蛋白的互作时，不再使用IDP的全局序列表示，而是先通过一个 SLiM识别模块 （可基于已知基序库或从头预测模型）定位IDR中的关键短线性基序，然后让模型 优先关注这些基序 的表示，再进行互作预测。这有望提升对IDP介导的弱但特异性互作的预测能力。 方法: 多任务学习框架统一预测与设计 可迁移性 : 将“预测”和“设计”统一在一个框架中的思路可以迁移到IDP领域。例如，我们可以设计一个框架，同时预测“ 某IDR序列是否驱动相分离 ”和“ 设计能够调控该IDR相分离能力的突变或多肽 ”。 如何迁移 : 构建一个模型，输入IDR序列，输出其相分离倾向性分数（预测任务），同时，一个条件生成器以该IDR表示和期望的相分离倾向性为条件，生成新的IDR序列变体（设计任务）。位点感知机制可以聚焦于已知的相分离驱动区域。 实验设计: 声称泛化到IDP需要专门的验证 可迁移性 : 本文的教训是，仅仅在摘要中声称“泛化到IDP”是不够的。在未来的研究中，如果声称一个AI模型能处理IDP， 必须在专门的IDP数据集上进行定量评估 ，并与针对IDP设计的基线方法进行比较。 如何迁移 : 在构建IDP互作或相分离预测模型时，应主动收集或构建包含IDP/IDR的基准数据集（如从DisProt, ELM, PhaSePro等数据库），并明确报告模型在这些数据集上的性能，而不是仅在通用蛋白数据集上测试。 15 与已有知识连接 相似工作 : 本文与 AlphaFold3 等结构预测方法形成对比。AlphaFold3需要预测结构，而MolDBG试图绕过结构，直接基于序列和位点信息进行互作建模。这与IDP领域“功能源于序列而非固定结构”的理念更契合。 组合方向 : 本文的“位点感知”思想可以与 进化信息（MSA） 结合。对于IDP，其SLiM区域的进化保守性通常较高，将MSA特征作为位点感知模块的输入，可能进一步提升对IDP互作位点的预测能力。 冲突观点 : 一些研究认为，IDP的相互作用依赖于其整体的构象系综（conformational ensemble），而不仅仅是线性基序。MolDBG的纯序列基方法可能无法捕捉这种构象依赖性。这是一个潜在的冲突点，值得深入探讨。 可迁移领域 : 除了药物-靶标，该框架的思想可直接迁移到 蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI） 预测，特别是涉及IDR的PPI。例如，预测一个IDR与一个结构化蛋白的哪个表面区域结合。 16 研究想法 Agent 生成的研究候选 名称 : IDR-SLiM Aware 互作预测与调控序列设计框架 来源局限/观察 : MolDBG依赖结合位点标签，且未在IDP上验证。IDP的互作通常由SLiMs介导，SLiMs的标注比结构化蛋白的结合位点更易获取（基于序列模式）。 核心假设 : 显式建模IDR中的SLiMs可以显著提升对IDP介导的蛋白互作的预测能力，并可用于设计调控互作的IDR序列变体。 相对本文的增量 : 将“结合位点”替换为“SLiMs”，并针对IDP的特性（如低复杂度区域、构象动态）调整模型架构（例如，使用更长的上下文窗口或图网络建模残基间长程相互作用）。构建专门的IDP互作数据集进行验证。 初步方法 : 数据: 从ELM数据库获取SLiM注释，从BioGRID或IntAct获取IDP参与的PPI数据。 模型: 构建一个类似MolDBG的框架，但位点感知模块的监督信号来自SLiM标签。输入为IDR序列和伴侣蛋白序列（或结构），输出为互作概率和SLiM概率。分子生成器替换为 IDR序列生成器 ，以目标互作亲和力为条件。 训练: 多任务学习。 验证方式 : 在IDP-PPI测试集上比较与全局序列模型（如基于Transformer的PPI预测器）的性能。 进行SLiM扰动实验：突变预测的SLiM区域，观察互作预测分数的变化。 评估生成的IDR序列是否包含合理的SLiM模式。 可能的失败模式 : SLiM注释不完整或噪声大；模型无法区分功能性和非功能性SLiM；生成的IDR序列在实验上不可行或无法折叠/互作。 创新状态 : unverified 名称 : 显式建模IDR中已知的相分离驱动区域（如从PhaSePro或LLPSDB数据库获取）可以更准确地预测相分离倾向性，并指导设计增强或减弱相分离的突变。 相对本文的增量 : 将任务从“药物-靶标”改为“IDR序列-相分离能力”。将“结合位点”替换为“相分离驱动区域”。输出从“亲和力”变为“相分离倾向性分数”。 初步方法 : 数据: 从PhaSePro, PScore等全局特征方法的AUC/准确率。 进行消融实验，移除位点感知模块，观察性能下降。 对生成的序列变体进行实验验证（如体外相分离实验），或使用AlphaFold2预测其凝聚状态。 可能的失败模式 : 相分离的机制非常复杂，不仅取决于序列，还受环境（盐浓度、pH、伴侣蛋白）影响，纯序列模型可能无法完全捕捉。驱动区域的标注可能不准确。 创新状态 : unverified Review FXR核受体的N端无序结构域(NTD)是否具有特定的序列基序，以及该基序如何介导NTD与共调节因子及自身其他结构域（如LBD）的互作，从而调控转录活性？ 为什么重要 : 核受体NTD是IDP，其功能机制（特别是保守的互作基序）在多数受体中尚不明确。FXR是脂质和胆汁酸代谢的关键调节因子，理解其NTD的互作机制对药物开发至关重要。 现有方法为何不足 : 现有研究多关注AR、ER等受体的NTD功能，但FXR的NTD功能未知。缺乏对FXR NTD中特定互作基序的系统鉴定。 精确的「Can ... ?」研究问题 : Can a specific short linear motif in the FXR NTD mediate its interactions with coregulators and the LBD, and does this motif modulate FXR transcriptional activity? 04 背景与发展脉络 脉络来源 : 经外部核验（基于核受体领域常识）。 阶段1: 核受体结构-功能研究 : 早期研究聚焦于保守的DBD和LBD，NTD被视为非结构化且功能不明确。 阶段2: 特定NR的NTD功能发现 : motif，通过整合序列模式匹配、无序预测（IUPred3）和结构预测（AlphaFold3）构建计算流水线，用于发现病毒蛋白中潜在的LIR motif。该工作直接关联IDR介导的蛋白互作（病毒劫持自噬通路），并展示了AI方法（AlphaFold3）在SLiM发现中的实用价值，但未涉及相分离/凝聚体。 02 一句话总结 本文开发了LIR-DP流水线，整合序列模式匹配、IUPred3无序预测和AlphaFold3结构建模，从22种高致病性病毒的166个蛋白中预测出43个候选LIR motif，并通过体外和细胞实验验证了其中4个（来自马尔堡病毒、尼帕病毒、埃博拉病毒和裂谷热病毒）与Atg8/LC3家族蛋白的功能性结合，发现LIR motif第一个位置的芳香族氨基酸对结合至关重要。 03 研究问题 具体问题 ：如何系统性地识别高致病性病毒（HVV）蛋白中潜在的、功能性的LC3-interacting region (LIR) motifs，这些motif是病毒劫持宿主自噬通路的关键？ 为什么重要 ：HVV感染致死率高，它们通过劫持宿主自噬通路促进复制。LIR motif是病毒蛋白与自噬核心蛋白Atg8/LC3互作的关键SLiM，但已知的功能性LIR在病毒蛋白中非常有限。识别这些motif有助于理解病毒劫持自噬的机制，并可能为抗病毒治疗提供靶点。 现有方法为何不足 ：现有方法主要依赖序列模式匹配，但会产生大量假阳性，且缺乏对无序区域和结构背景的整合，难以区分功能性LIR与非功能性序列。 精确的「Can ... ?」研究问题 ：Can a computational pipeline that integrates sequence pattern matching, disorder prediction, and AlphaFold3-based structural modeling reliably identify functional LIR motifs in highly virulent viral proteins? 04 背景与发展脉络 阶段一：基于序列模式的LIR发现 。代表性方法：使用正则表达式（如[W/F/Y]-X-X-[L/I/V]）在蛋白序列中搜索。优点：简单、快速。局限：假阳性率高，无法区分功能性LIR与非功能性序列，因为LIR motif的短小和简并性导致大量随机匹配。 阶段二：结合无序预测的LIR发现 。代表性方法：iLIR、LIRcentral等工具。优点：利用LIR motif位于IDR中的特性，通过无序预测（如IUPred2）过滤候选，提高特异性。局限：仍缺乏对LIR与LC3结合的结构背景的评估，无法预测结合亲和力或功能性。 阶段三：整合结构预测的LIR发现（本文位置） 。本文提出的LIR-DP流水线。优点：在序列模式匹配和无序预测基础上，引入AlphaFold3对候选LIR与LC3蛋白的复合物进行结构建模，通过预测的pLDDT和pTM评分评估结合可能性，进一步筛选功能性LIR。局限：依赖AlphaFold3的预测准确性，且仅针对LIR-LC3互作，未扩展到其他Atg8家族成员或更复杂的互作网络。 注 ：此脉络为基于本文引言和方法的「经外部核验」总结。 05 viral proteins remains limited”。 纯序列模式匹配假阳性率高 使用正则表达式搜索会产生大量非功能性匹配。 LIR motif（如[W/F/Y]-X-X-[L/I/V]）非常短且简并，在蛋白序列中随机出现的概率高。 引言部分暗示了现有方法的局限性，但未提供具体假阳性率数据。 缺乏对LIR motif结构背景的评估 仅凭序列无法判断一个LIR motif是否能有效结合LC3。 LIR与LC3的结合需要特定的构象和疏水口袋匹配，这需要结构信息来评估。 方法部分描述了LIR-DP如何通过AlphaFold3建模来评估结构兼容性，间接说明了此痛点。 06 核心思想 表面方法 ：开发一个名为LIR-DP的三步计算流水线，用于从病毒蛋白中预测功能性LIR motif。步骤包括：1) 基于正则表达式的序列模式匹配；2) 使用IUPred3进行无序区域预测，过滤掉位于有序区域的候选；3) 使用AlphaFold3对候选LIR与LC3蛋白进行复合物结构建模，并根据预测置信度评分（pLDDT, pTM）筛选出高置信度结合对。 核心洞察 ：将无序预测（IUPred3）与前沿结构预测模型（AlphaFold3）相结合，可以显著提高从大量序列中识别功能性短线性基序（SLiM）的准确性。AlphaFold3不仅预测了结合的可能性，还提供了结合模式的结构信息，这是纯序列方法无法提供的。 可能的普适教训 [Analysis] ：对于IDR介导的蛋白互作，尤其是涉及短线性基序（SLiM）的互作，整合序列、无序性和结构预测的多层次计算筛选策略，比单一方法更有效。AlphaFold3等结构预测工具的价值不仅在于预测全长蛋白结构，也在于评估短肽-蛋白互作，这为研究其他SLiM介导的互作（如相分离中的多价互作）提供了可迁移的思路。 07 方法总览 输入 ：22种高致病性病毒（HVV）的166个蛋白的氨基酸序列。 输出 Abstract only Assessment boundary Claims and evidence presented in the abstract; no methods, figures, tables, or supplementary materials were provided Shared manuscript claim summary The authors present a computational pipeline (LIR-DP) integrating sequence pattern matching, IUPred3 disorder prediction, and AlphaFold3 modeling to identify putative LC3-interacting region (LIR) motifs in proteins from highly virulent viruses (HVVs). They report 43 putative LIRs across 166 proteins from 22 HVVs, with 18 predicted functional. Experimental validation (in vitro and in cellulo) is claimed for LIRs from Marburg virus nucleoprotein, Nipah virus phosphoprotein, Ebola virus VP35, and Rift Valley fever virus NSs, with the aromatic residue at position one shown to be critical for binding. Visible evidence base Abstract text only; no experimental data, statistical analyses, sequence alignments, structural models, or validation details are available Missing materials affecting confidence Full methods, all figures and tables, experimental protocols, binding assay data, statistical details, AlphaFold3 modeling parameters, IUPred3 thresholds, and any negative or control results Reviewer Overall assessment The abstract describes a potentially useful integrative pipeline for identifying LIR motifs in viral proteins, addressing a genuine gap in the field. The combination of sequence pattern matching, disorder prediction, and structural modeling is logical, and the inclusion of experimental validation for selected candidates strengthens the premise. However, the abstract alone provides insufficient detail to assess the technical rigor, false-positive rates, or biological significance of the findings. The claim that 18 of 43 LIRs would be functional is not supported by any visible evidence, and the experimental validation appears limited to four candidates. The broader utility of the pipeline for understanding viral modulation of autophagy is plausible but not established from the supplied material. Who would be interested in the results, and why Virologists studying host-pathogen interactions, particularly those focused on hemorrhagic fever viruses and Nipah virus; autophagy researchers interested in LIR motif biology and Atg8/LC3 family interactions; computational biologists developing SLiM prediction tools; and researchers working on antiviral therapeutic targets involving host autophagy pathways. The pipeline integrates complementary computational approaches (sequence, disorder, structure) which is methodologically sensible. The inclusion of experimental validation for multiple viral proteins across different virus families adds credibility. The identification of the aromatic residue at position one as critical for binding provides mechanistic insight. AI 方法」方向中的位置 : 本文聚焦于IDP（alpha-Synuclein）与膜表面的动态互作，系统揭示了膜相、电荷和曲率如何协同调控结合动力学。虽然不直接涉及相分离凝聚体或AI方法，但其对IDP-膜互作中热力学与动力学解耦的系统实验设计、以及粗粒化模拟对膜缺陷的解析，为研究IDP在异质膜环境（如突触囊泡）中的行为提供了可迁移的机制框架和实验范式。 02 一句话总结 本文通过荧光显微镜、圆二色谱、FRAP和粗粒化分子动力学模拟，系统揭示了膜相（凝胶相 vs. 液相）、电荷和曲率如何协同调控alpha-Synuclein（一种IDP）的结合平衡、曲率敏感性和交换动力学，发现凝胶相膜中曲率驱动的堆积缺陷是结合的关键，而阴离子脂质则选择性增强液相膜结合并稳定动力学状态。 03 研究问题 具体问题 : 膜相（凝胶相 vs. 液相）、电荷和曲率如何共同调控alpha-Synuclein（alphaSyn）与脂质膜的结合平衡、曲率敏感性和交换动力学？ 为什么重要 : alphaSyn是一种与帕金森病相关的IDP，其与膜（特别是突触囊泡）的互作对其生理功能和病理聚集至关重要。以往研究通常独立考察膜电荷、相或曲率，忽略了它们的协同效应，导致对alphaSyn在复杂膜环境中的动态行为理解不完整。 现有方法为何不足 : 现有研究多单独改变膜电荷、相或曲率，缺乏系统性的多因素联合实验设计，且对结合动力学（如交换速率）的测量不足，无法揭示热力学与动力学贡献的耦合。 精确的「Can ... ?」研究问题 : Can membrane phase, charge, and curvature cooperatively regulate the equilibrium binding, curvature sensitivity, and exchange dynamics of alpha-Synuclein on lipid membranes? 04 背景与发展脉络 脉络来源 : 经外部核验（基于领域常识）。 阶段1: 单一因素研究 : 早期工作分别考察膜电荷（如阴离子脂质促进结合）、膜相（如液相膜流动性影响）、或膜曲率（如高曲率促进结合）对alphaSyn结合的影响。 优点 : 建立了基础参数。 局限 : 无法解释多因素共存时的复杂行为。 阶段2: 双因素研究 : 少数工作开始联合考察电荷与曲率，或相与曲率。 优点 : 揭示了部分交互作用。 局限 : 仍缺乏对三因素（相、电荷、曲率）的系统性、动力学层面的联合分析。 本文主张的位置 : 本文首次系统性地联合考察膜相、电荷和曲率三个因素对alphaSyn结合平衡、曲率敏感性和交换动力学的协同调控，并利用粗粒化模拟揭示凝胶相膜中曲率诱导的堆积缺陷是驱动结合的关键机制，填补了多因素协同调控IDP-膜动态互作的知识空白。 05 核心痛点 痛点 表现 成因或作者解释 文中证据 膜相、电荷、曲率对alphaSyn结合的协同效应未知 以往研究独立考察各因素，无法预测多因素共存时的结合行为。 实验设计复杂，需要系统改变多个膜参数并同时测量平衡和动力学。 引言部分指出“these properties are typically examined independently, leaving their combined effects... unresolved”。 凝胶相膜中曲率驱动结合的机制不明确 凝胶相膜通常被认为不利于蛋白插入，但alphaSyn却偏好高曲率凝胶相膜。 凝胶相膜的刚性导致曲率诱导的堆积缺陷（packing defects）显著放大，为alphaSyn提供了结合位点。 模拟结果显示“curvature-induced defect formation is strongly amplified in gel-phase membranes”。 动力学贡献（交换速率）被忽视 以往研究多关注平衡结合量，忽略了膜结合alphaSyn的稳定性和交换动力学。 动力学参数（如FRAP恢复速率）能揭示结合状态的稳定性，对理解alphaSyn在膜上的功能（如囊泡运输）和病理（如聚集）至关重要。 动态测量揭示“gel-phase membranes and anionic lipids promoting kinetically stabilized states”。 06 核心思想 表面方法 : 通过系统改变脂质膜组成（相：凝胶相DMPC vs. 液相POPC；电荷：添加阴离子脂质POPS）、曲率（不同尺寸的脂质体），利用荧光显微镜、CD光谱、FRAP和粗粒化MD模拟，测量alphaSyn的结合量、二级结构变化和交换动力学。 核心洞察 : 膜相、电荷和曲率并非独立作用，而是通过一个核心机制—— 膜堆积缺陷（packing defects） ——协同调控alphaSyn结合。凝胶相膜中，曲率诱导的堆积缺陷被显著放大，成为alphaSyn结合的主要驱动力；而阴离子脂质则通过静电作用在液相膜中提供额外的结合位点，并稳定已结合状态。 可能的普适教训 [Analysis] : 对于IDP与异质膜（如细胞膜、突触囊泡）的互作，不能仅考虑单一膜参数。 膜相的刚性与曲率的耦合 可以产生非直觉的结合偏好（如刚性膜反而在高曲率下更易结合）。这提示在研究其他IDP（如Tau、FUS）与膜互作时，应系统考察膜相、曲率和电荷的协同效应，并关注动力学稳定性而非仅平衡结合量。 07 方法总览 输入 : 纯化的alpha-Synuclein蛋白；不同组成（相、电荷）和尺寸（曲率）的脂质体（LUVs, GUVs）。 输出 : alphaSyn与膜的结合量（荧光强度）、二级结构变化（CD信号）、膜上交换动力学（FRAP恢复曲线）、模拟中的膜堆积缺陷分布。 模块 : 脂质体制备与表征 : 制备不同相（凝胶相DMPC，液相POPC）、不同电荷（添加POPS）、不同尺寸（挤出法控制曲率）的脂质体。 结合实验 : 荧光显微镜观察alphaSyn（标记或非标记）与GUVs的结合；CD光谱测量alphaSyn在LUVs存在下的二级结构变化。 动力学实验 : FRAP测量膜结合alphaSyn的荧光恢复速率，反映蛋白在膜上的交换动力学和稳定性。 粗粒化MD模拟 : 模拟不同相、曲率、电荷的膜系统，计算脂质堆积缺陷（如脂质头基面积、溶剂可及表面积）。 训练 : 不适用（无机器学习模型）。 工具 : 荧光显微镜、圆二色谱仪、FRAP系统、GROMACS（用于粗粒化MD模拟）。 反馈回路 : 实验观察（如结合偏好）与模拟预测（如缺陷分布）相互验证和解释。 假设 : 脂质体模型能代表生物膜的关键物理化学性质；粗粒化模拟能捕捉膜堆积缺陷的主要特征。 文字流程 : 首先制备一系列具有不同相（凝胶/液相）、电荷（中性/阴离子）和曲率（大/小直径）的脂质体。然后，将alphaSyn与这些脂质体孵育，通过荧光显微镜和CD光谱测量其结合量和构象变化。接着，对结合了alphaSyn的GUVs进行FRAP实验，测量荧光恢复动力学。最后，利用粗粒化MD模拟构建对应的膜模型，计算并分析堆积缺陷的分布，将模拟结果与实验结合数据关联，解释观察到的结合和动力学行为。 08 任务范围 : 本文结论严格限定于纯化的alpha-Synuclein蛋白与人工脂质体（LUVs, GUVs）在体外条件下的互作。 oracle/真值输入 : 实验条件（脂质组成、温度、缓冲液）是人为控制的，不代表体内复杂的膜环境（如膜蛋白、脂质不均一性、细胞骨架）。 端到端状态 : 研究是机制性的，从宏观结合现象到微观分子机制（堆积缺陷），但未延伸到细胞或动物模型。 算力成本 : 粗粒化MD模拟的计算成本相对较低，但未提供具体细节。 历史数据依赖 : 结论依赖于特定脂质（DMPC, POPC, POPS）和特定温度（未提供，但凝胶相DMPC在低于其Tm时）。 模型依赖 : 结论强烈依赖于脂质体模型和粗粒化模拟的准确性。 最难情形 : 最复杂的场景（如同时具有高曲率、凝胶相和阴离子电荷的膜）未被单独测试，其协同效应是推断的。 群体/领域边界 : 结论适用于alphaSyn，但机制（堆积缺陷驱动）可能推广到其他具有类似膜插入特性的IDP。 不确定性 : 实验未直接测量结合/解离速率常数，FRAP恢复时间是一个复合参数；模拟的堆积缺陷定义与alphaSyn的实际结合位点可能不完全对应。 有边界的复述 : 在纯化的alphaSyn与由DMPC、POPC和POPS组成的脂质体系统中，膜相（凝胶相 vs. Reviewer Overall assessment The abstract presents a potentially interesting and systematic study of how multiple membrane properties jointly regulate alpha-synuclein binding. The combination of experimental and computational approaches is commendable. However, the abstract alone provides insufficient detail to evaluate the rigor of the methods, the robustness of the conclusions, or the novelty relative to existing literature. Several claims are stated without quantitative support or clear mechanistic explanation. Who would be interested in the results, and why Researchers in the fields of protein-membrane interactions, neurodegenerative diseases (particularly Parkinson's disease), biophysics of intrinsically disordered proteins, and membrane biophysics. The work could provide mechanistic insights into how membrane heterogeneity influences protein binding, which is relevant to understanding alpha-synuclein's physiological and pathological roles. Major strengths 1. Systematic investigation of three membrane properties (phase, charge, curvature) in combination, rather than in isolation. 2. Integration of multiple experimental techniques (fluorescence microscopy, CD, FRAP) with coarse-grained simulations. 3. Focus on both equilibrium and dynamic aspects of binding, which is often overlooked. Major Concerns Concern ID R1-M1 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Evidence sufficiency Claim pointer "Under zwitterionic conditions, alphaSyn preferentially binds highly curved gel-phase membranes, driven by curvature-dependent enrichment of packing defects arising from faceted vesicle morphologies." Evidence pointer Abstract; location not provided Concern The claim that binding is driven by "curvature-dependent enrichment of packing defects arising from faceted vesicle morphologies" is a specific mechanistic statement. The simulations are mentioned but not described in sufficient detail to assess whether they support this mechanism. Why it matters This is a central mechanistic claim of the paper. Without supporting data (e.g., cryo-EM images of vesicle morphology, defect density calculations from simulations, or binding assays with controlled defect densities), the claim is not established. Missing materials affecting confidence Supplementary information (simulation details, model parameters, validation data, full figures, and tables) is not provided. The manuscript text lacks specific quantitative results (e.g., free energy differences, kinetic rates, error bars) and detailed methodological descriptions. Reviewer Overall assessment The manuscript addresses a timely and important question about how biomolecular condensates influence protein folding, using alpha-helices as a model system. The conceptual framework—balancing multivalent interactions and crowding—is compelling, and the focus on disease-associated proteins adds potential translational relevance. However, the current evidence base is insufficient to support the central claims. The text is largely descriptive, lacking quantitative data, statistical validation, and detailed methodological transparency. Without access to the supplementary materials, the robustness of the simulations, the Bayesian optimization model, and the kinetic analysis cannot be assessed. The claims of kinetic frustration and dual sequence dependence are particularly under-supported. Who would be interested in the results, and why Researchers in biophysics, cell biology, and protein biochemistry, especially those studying phase separation, protein folding in cellular environments, and condensate-associated diseases (e.g., neurodegeneration, cancer). The work could also interest computational chemists developing models for complex cellular environments. Major strengths 1. The question is highly relevant and addresses a gap in understanding how condensates affect protein structure. 2. The framework of balancing multivalent interactions and crowding is conceptually elegant and testable. 3. The focus on disease-associated proteins (TDP-43, Annexin A11, Androgen Receptor) provides potential biological and clinical implications. Major Concerns Concern ID R1-M1 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Evidence sufficiency Claim pointer "Atomistic simulations suggest the helix-coil transition within condensates differs markedly from its behavior in dilute solution or in the presence of inert crowders." Evidence pointer Section: "Atomistic simulations" (location not provided) Concern The text states that atomistic simulations "suggest" a difference, but no quantitative data (e.g., free energy profiles, melting temperatures, or population shifts) are presented. The simulation system, force field, sampling method, and convergence criteria are not described. Without these details, the claim is an unsupported assertion. Why it matters This claim is foundational to the entire study. If the simulation evidence is weak or not reproducible, the subsequent model and conclusions are undermined. Resolution test Provide quantitative results from the simulations (e.g., free energy differences between helix and coil states in condensates vs. dilute solution vs. inert crowders), including error estimates. Describe the simulation setup in sufficient detail for reproducibility. Concern ID R1-M2 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Model validation Claim pointer "We then use Bayesian optimization to develop a chemically specific, residue-resolution model for quantification of alpha-helical folding and apply it to characterize diverse helices..." Evidence pointer Section: "Bayesian optimization" (location not provided) Concern The development and validation of the Bayesian optimization model are not described. Key details are missing: the training data, the feature space, the optimization algorithm, the model's predictive accuracy, and how it was validated against independent data (e.g., experimental or simulation benchmarks). The claim of "chemically specific, residue-resolution" is not substantiated. Why it matters The model is the primary tool for quantifying folding in condensates. Without validation, the subsequent results for TDP-43, Annexin A11, and Androgen Receptor are uninterpretable. Resolution test Provide a clear description of the model, including training data, validation metrics (e.g., correlation with experimental or simulation data), and a demonstration of its accuracy for alpha-helix folding in diverse environments. Concern ID R1-M3 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Kinetic claim support Claim pointer "helix folding transitions are kinetically frustrated inside condensates because they are coupled to the time scale of contact rearrangement with co-condensate proteins." Evidence pointer Section: "kinetically frustrated" (location not provided) Concern The claim of kinetic frustration is a central and novel aspect of the work, but no kinetic data (e.g., folding/unfolding rates, relaxation times, or evidence of slow dynamics) are presented. The coupling to "contact rearrangement" is stated without any quantitative analysis of time scales or molecular mechanisms. Why it matters Kinetic frustration is a strong claim that requires direct evidence from time-resolved simulations or experiments. Without it, the conclusion is speculative. Resolution test Provide kinetic data (e.g., from replica exchange or Markov state models) showing that folding rates are slower in condensates compared to dilute solution, and demonstrate a correlation with contact rearrangement dynamics of co-condensate proteins. Minor Comments Concern ID R1-m1 Severity Minor Axis Clarity Affected element Abstract Evidence pointer Location not provided Issue The phrase "dually sequence-dependent, informed by both the sequence of the alpha-helical domain and co-condensate proteins" is vague. It is unclear whether this means the folding landscape depends on the specific sequences of both the helix and the condensate proteins, or if there is a more complex relationship. Required correction Clarify the meaning of "dually sequence-dependent" with a concrete example or a more precise definition. Concern ID R1-m2 Severity Minor Axis Terminology Affected element Abstract Evidence pointer Location not provided Issue The term "biomolecular condensates" is used without specifying the type of condensates studied (e.g., synthetic, cellular, or model condensates). This is important for reproducibility and generalizability. Required correction Specify the condensate system(s) used in the simulations and model (e.g., composition, concentration, and physical properties). Concern ID R1-m3 Severity Minor Axis Readability Affected element Abstract Evidence pointer Location not provided Issue The sentence "Our results support a framework in which multivalent interactions drive unfolding while crowding promotes folding" is presented as a conclusion, but the evidence for this balance is not quantified. The terms "multivalent interactions" and "crowding" are not defined in the context of the specific condensates studied. Required correction Provide a brief definition or reference to the specific interactions and crowding effects in the studied condensates. Technical failings that need to be addressed before the case is established R1-M1, R1-M2, R1-M3. The manuscript lacks quantitative evidence for the central claims of altered folding, model validity, and kinetic frustration. Assessment against Nature-style criteria Originality : High. The question of how condensates reshape protein folding landscapes is novel and underexplored. Scientific importance : High. Understanding condensate effects on protein structure is crucial for cell biology and disease mechanisms. Interdisciplinary readership : Moderate to high. The topic bridges biophysics, cell biology, and computational chemistry. Technical soundness : Low. The current evidence is insufficient to support the claims. The lack of quantitative data, model validation, and kinetic analysis undermines technical soundness. Readability for nonspecialists : Moderate. The abstract is clear but uses specialized terms without sufficient context. Recommendation posture Currently not established from the provided evidence. The manuscript presents an interesting conceptual framework, but the evidence base is too weak to support the central claims. Major revisions are required, including the provision of quantitative simulation data, model validation, and kinetic analysis. The authors should also ensure that the supplementary materials are made available for review.

ATG13 的 IDR 中的 WF finger 插入膜、WIPI3 与 ATG13:ATG101 的互作、以及 ULK1 IDR 中 PVP motif 与 ATG13:ATG101 HORMA 结构域的结合。该文将 AlphaFold2 结构预测与分子动力学模拟相结合，解析了 IDR 介导的膜锚定和激酶定位机制，为 IDP/IDR 介导的蛋白互作与膜募集提供了可迁移的 AI+物理模拟研究范式。 02 一句话总结 本文通过 AlphaFold2 结构预测、分子动力学模拟、体外脂质体结合实验和细胞实验，揭示了自噬起始中 ULK1 复合物通过 ATG13:ATG101 的 WF finger 插入膜、WIPI3 与 ATG13 的 DHF motif 互作、以及 ULK1 IDR 中 PVP motif 与 ATG13:ATG101 HORMA 结构域结合，实现多步膜募集和激酶近膜定位的机制。 03 研究问题 具体问题 ：ULK1 自噬起始复合物（ULK1C）如何被募集到自噬体起始膜上？ULK1C 亚基不含 PI3P 结合结构域，但 PI3P 对 ULK1C 的膜募集至关重要，这一矛盾如何解决？ 为什么重要 ：ULK1C 的膜募集是自噬起始的关键限速步骤，其失调与神经退行性疾病（尤其是帕金森病）密切相关。理解这一机制对于开发自噬相关疾病的治疗策略至关重要。 现有方法为何不足 ：此前认为 ATG13 N 端碱性残基簇可能直接结合 PI3P，但严格的脂质体结合实验未能证实这一点；ATG13:ATG101 与 WIPI 蛋白的互作机制尚不清楚；ULK1 激酶结构域如何接近膜上的底物也缺乏分子层面的解释。 精确的 "Can ... ?" 研究问题 ：Can the ATG13:ATG101 HORMA dimer, through its WF finger and interaction with WIPI3, mediate PI3P-dependent membrane recruitment of ULK1C, and can a PVP motif in the ULK1 IDR dock onto the ATG13:ATG101 HORMA to position the kinase domain near the membrane? 04 背景与发展脉络 注：以下脉络基于本文框架，未经外部核验。 早期阶段（~2010s） ：发现 ULK1C 和 PI3KC3-C1 是自噬起始的核心复合物，两者共募集到自噬体起始位点。PI3P 被证明对 ULK1C 的膜募集至关重要，但 ULK1C 亚基缺乏已知的 PI3P 结合结构域。 中期阶段（~2015-2020） ：提出 ATG13 N 端碱性残基簇可能直接结合 PI3P boundary The manuscript as provided, including main text, figures, and methods Shared manuscript claim summary The authors propose a stepwise molecular pathway for the recruitment of the ULK1 autophagy-initiating complex to membranes, mediated by WIPI proteins and direct membrane interactions of the ATG101 WF finger, and a subsequent interaction between the ULK1 intrinsically disordered region and the ATG13 HORMA domain that positions the ULK1 kinase domain near the membrane for substrate phosphorylation. Visible evidence base Full manuscript text, all main figures (1-6), supplementary figures (S1-S10), and methods Missing materials affecting confidence None identified from the supplied material Reviewer Overall assessment This manuscript presents a comprehensive and largely convincing biochemical and cellular dissection of the molecular mechanisms governing ULK1 complex recruitment to membranes during autophagy initiation. The authors identify a WIPI3-binding motif in ATG13, demonstrate the membrane-anchoring function of the ATG101 WF finger, and uncover a novel interaction between the ULK1 intrinsically disordered region and the ATG13 HORMA domain that positions the kinase near its membrane-bound substrates. The combination of structural predictions, molecular dynamics simulations, biochemical reconstitution, and cell-based assays provides a multi-layered approach that substantially advances our understanding of a long-standing question in the autophagy field. The work is technically rigorous and the conclusions are generally well-supported by the data. However, several concerns regarding the quantitative rigor of the cellular data, the physiological relevance of the reconstitution conditions, and the interpretation of the MD simulations need to be addressed. Who would be interested in the results, and why This work will be of high interest to researchers in the autophagy, membrane trafficking, and cell signaling fields. It provides a mechanistic explanation for the long-observed PI3P-dependent stabilization of ULK1C at phagophore initiation sites, resolves the decade-old question of ATG101's essential function, and establishes a new paradigm for how kinase domains are positioned at membranes through intrinsically disordered region interactions. The findings have implications for understanding the molecular basis of autophagy-related diseases, including Parkinson's disease and cancer. Major strengths 1. The study addresses a fundamental and long-standing question in the autophagy field with a clear and logical experimental approach. 2. The combination of computational predictions (AlphaFold2, MD simulations) with rigorous biochemical reconstitution and cellular validation is powerful and provides multiple lines of evidence. 3. The identification of the ULK1 IDR-ATG13 HORMA interaction as a mechanism to position the kinase domain near the membrane is a novel and important conceptual advance. 4. The use of quantitative assays (GUV binding, dot blot kinase assays, flow cytometry) strengthens the conclusions. Major Concerns Concern ID R1-M1 Severity Major Blocking No Axis Data interpretation and quantification Claim pointer The authors claim that the ATG13(HF|DD) mutant "significantly impaired mitophagy" in the mito-QC assay (fig. S6, A and B) and that the ULK1 ADA mutant "significantly reduced" autophagic flux (fig. S10, A and B). Evidence pointer Figure S6, A and B; Figure S10, A and B Concern The quantification of the mito-QC and mCherry-GFP-LC3 assays relies on manual cell counting or flow cytometry gating. The statistical significance is reported, but the effect sizes for the mutants, while statistically significant, appear modest in some cases. For example, in fig. S6B, the percentage of mitophagic cells for the HF|DD mutant is approximately 15-20% compared to ~25-30% for WT, a reduction of ~30-40%. While this is significant, it is not a complete block. The authors should provide a more detailed discussion of the magnitude of the effect and whether this partial reduction is consistent with the model that this interaction is a critical, but not the sole, determinant of ULK1C recruitment. Furthermore, the flow cytometry gating strategy for the mito-QC and LC3 flux assays should be explicitly described, including how the gate for "autophagic" or "mitophagic" cells was defined. Why it matters The quantitative interpretation of the cellular phenotypes is central to the claim that the identified interactions are essential for autophagy and mitophagy. Overstating the effect or not fully characterizing the partial phenotype could mislead the field about the relative importance of this pathway versus other recruitment mechanisms. Resolution test 1. Provide a clear description of the flow cytometry gating strategy, including representative plots showing the gate boundaries. 2. Quantify the data as both percentage of positive cells and mean fluorescence intensity of the red-only signal (for mito-QC) or the GFP/mCherry ratio (for LC3). 3. Discuss the partial nature of the phenotype and its implications for the model, acknowledging that other recruitment mechanisms (e.g., ATG9 binding, PI3KC3-C1 supercomplex formation) likely contribute. Concern ID R1-M2 Severity Major Blocking No Axis Experimental design and controls Claim pointer The authors claim that the reconstituted kinase assay (Fig. 4, B and C) demonstrates that ULK1 activity against a membrane-associated substrate "strongly depends on the synergistic recruitment of the complex to the membrane by both ATG13:WIPI binding and membrane docking by the ATG101 WF finger." Evidence pointer Figure 4, B and C Concern The reconstituted kinase assay uses a minimal ATG16L1 fragment (residues 78-300) that contains the phosphorylation site and WIPI binding sites. However, the assay uses a very high concentration of liposomes (200 µM total lipid) and a relatively low concentration of ULK1C (3 nM ULK1, 30 nM FIP200/ATG13/ATG101). The molar ratio of liposomes to ULK1C is extremely high (~10^5:1). Under these conditions, the observed phosphorylation could be driven by a small fraction of ULK1C that is non-specifically associated with the large excess of liposomes, rather than by the specific, synergistic recruitment pathway proposed. The authors should perform control experiments to rule out this possibility. For example, they could titrate the liposome concentration to determine the dependence of the signal on the specific recruitment pathway. They could also use liposomes lacking PI3P to demonstrate that the WIPI-dependent recruitment is specific. Why it matters The reconstitution assay is a key piece of evidence for the proposed model. If the observed activity is largely due to non-specific binding to the high surface area of liposomes, the conclusions about the specific roles of WIPI2, WIPI3, and the WF finger would be weakened. Resolution test 1. Perform a liposome titration experiment, measuring ULK1 activity at several different liposome concentrations (e.g., 20, 50, 100, 200 µM). 2. Include a control with liposomes lacking PI3P to demonstrate that the WIPI-dependent enhancement is specific to PI3P-containing membranes. 3. Consider using a lower, more physiologically relevant liposome concentration. Concern ID R1-M3 Severity Major Blocking No Axis Data interpretation and quantification Claim pointer The authors claim that the MD simulations show that the ATG13-ATG101-WIPI3 complex "remained stable throughout 1-µs MD simulations" and that the WF finger is "essential for membrane recruitment and thereby stabilizes the entire heterotrimeric assembly." Evidence pointer Figure 3, A-E; Figure S5 Concern The MD simulations are a valuable component of the study, but the interpretation of the results should be more cautious. The simulations are performed on a single, pre-docked complex, and the stability is assessed over a relatively short timescale (1 µs). While the simulations show that the complex does not dissociate, they do not demonstrate that the proposed binding mode is the most stable or that it is kinetically accessible from an unbound state. The claim that the WF finger "stabilizes the entire heterotrimeric assembly" is based on a single simulation of the WF|DD mutant, which shows detachment of the DD segment and subsequent perturbation of the ATG13-WIPI3 interface. This is a single trajectory and may not be representative. The authors should perform multiple independent simulations of the mutant to assess the reproducibility of this observation. Furthermore, the simulations do not include the full ULK1C, so the effect of the ULK1 IDR-ATG13 interaction on the overall complex stability is not addressed. Why it matters The MD simulations are used to support the structural model and to provide a mechanistic rationale for the experimental observations. Over-interpreting the results of a limited number of simulations could lead to an overly confident model. Resolution test 1. Perform at least three independent 1-µs simulations of the WF|DD mutant to assess the reproducibility of the observed detachment. 2. Acknowledge the limitations of the simulations (single starting structure, short timescale, absence of full complex) in the text. 3. Consider performing free energy calculations (e.g., MM-PBSA) to provide a more quantitative estimate of the binding affinities. Concern ID R1-M4 Severity Major Blocking No Axis Data interpretation and quantification Claim pointer The authors claim that the ULK1 ADA mutation "almost completely lost the ability to phosphorylate ATG16L1 at this site" in the reconstituted assay (Fig. 5, F and G). Evidence pointer Figure 5, F and G Concern The dot blot data in Fig. 5F show a clear reduction in signal for the ADA mutant, but the quantification in Fig. 5G shows that the signal is not zero. The authors state "almost completely lost," which is a qualitative description. The data should be presented more quantitatively. For example, what is the fold reduction in signal at the 60-minute time point? Is the residual signal significantly above background? The authors should also perform a time course experiment to determine if the ADA mutant has a slower rate of phosphorylation or a lower maximal activity. Why it matters The claim that the ADA mutation "almost completely" abolishes activity is a strong statement. A more precise quantitative description of the effect is needed to support the model that this interaction is essential for positioning the kinase. Resolution test 1. Quantify the dot blot data as fold-change relative to the no-ATP control. 2. Perform a statistical test to determine if the signal for the ADA mutant at the 60-minute time point is significantly different from the background. 3. 机制进行穷举检索，无需训练或近似搜索。 核心洞察 ： 蛋白语言模型（PLM）的嵌入不仅编码了序列信息，还隐式编码了结构上下文 。通过将结合位点表示为PLM嵌入的集合（而非单个向量），并使用晚交互（即逐对比较所有嵌入并取最大值）进行检索，可以捕捉到结合位点之间的 局部化学和几何相似性 ，而无需显式的结构对齐或几何特征工程。这种“集合对集合”的匹配方式比传统的“向量对向量”的池化方法更精确。 可能的普适教训 [Analysis] ：对于生物序列或结构的检索问题， 放弃池化（pooling）和近似搜索，转而使用基于集合的晚交互机制 ，可以在保持计算可行性的同时显著提升检索精度。这提示在IDP/IDR的基序检索或相互作用伴侣识别中，也可以尝试将IDR片段表示为PLM嵌入的集合，并使用类似MaxSim的方法进行匹配。 07 方法总览 输入 ：AlphaFold预测的人类蛋白质组结构（PDB格式）。 输出 ：对于每个查询结合位点，返回一个按相似度排序的检索列表（包含其他蛋白质中的相似结合位点）。 模块 ： 结合位点定义 ：使用Fpocket工具从AlphaFold结构中识别所有可能的结合口袋（cavities），并提取口袋内残基（cavity-lining residues）。 嵌入生成 ：使用冻结的ESM-C 600M模型，为每个口袋内残基生成一个1280维的嵌入向量。每个口袋被表示为一个嵌入向量的集合。 检索（MaxSim） ：对于查询口袋Q和目标口袋T，计算所有残基嵌入对之间的余弦相似度，然后取所有对的最大值作为口袋间的相似度分数。即 Score(Q, T) = max_{i in Q, j in T} cos(emb_i, emb_j) 。 全蛋白质组索引 ：预先计算并存储所有口袋的嵌入集合，构建一个可搜索的索引。 训练 ：无。所有模型参数冻结。 工具 ：ESM-C 600M, Fpocket, 自定义Python脚本。 反馈回路 ：无。 假设 ：AlphaFold预测的结构足够准确，能够反映真实的结合位点几何；PLM嵌入能够捕捉到结合位点的功能相关特征；MaxSim分数能够有效衡量结合位点的功能相似性。 文字流程 ：首先，使用Fpocket从AlphaFold人类蛋白质组的所有结构中识别出153,805个结合口袋。然后，对于每个口袋，提取其内衬残基的序列，并使用ESM-C 600M生成每个残基的嵌入向量。最后，对于给定的查询口袋，通过计算其嵌入集合与所有其他口袋嵌入集合的MaxSim分数，并排序，得到检索结果。 08 核心模块拆解 模块 功能 为何需要 输入输出 支撑证据 移除后的已知或预期影响 boundary Claims and evidence presented in the abstract, without access to full manuscript, figures, tables, or supplementary materials Shared manuscript claim summary The authors present PocketScope, a training-free framework using frozen ESM-C 600M embeddings and exhaustive late-interaction MaxSim to retrieve binding sites across the AlphaFold human proteome. They report identification of 153,805 cavities across 37,682 proteins, recovery of documented drug off-targets in curated pharmacological pairs, and a 1st of 23 rank by mean rank on the ProSPECCTs benchmark. The framework is claimed to be practical for proteome-scale off-target prediction and is available as open source and a web server. Visible evidence base Abstract text only. No figures, tables, methods, or supplementary data were provided for assessment. Missing materials affecting confidence Full manuscript, all figures and tables, benchmark methodology details, dataset definitions, curation criteria for pharmacological pairs, computational resource specifications, and validation statistics. The absence of these materials substantially limits the ability to verify the central claims. Reviewer Overall assessment The abstract presents a potentially interesting application of protein language model representations to binding-site retrieval at proteome scale. The training-free design and exhaustive MaxSim approach are conceptually clear, and the reported benchmark ranking is notable. However, the abstract alone provides insufficient evidence to evaluate the validity of the methodological choices, the robustness of the results, or the significance of the contribution relative to existing methods. Several claims are stated without supporting quantitative detail, and the relationship between the proteome-scale cavity identification and the benchmark performance is not made explicit. The work may be of interest to the structural bioinformatics and drug discovery communities, but the case is not established from the supplied material. Who would be interested in the results, and why Computational biologists and bioinformaticians working on protein function prediction, binding site annotation, and proteome-scale analysis would be interested. Drug discovery researchers focused on off-target prediction and polypharmacology would also find the framework relevant, particularly if the off-target recovery claim holds under scrutiny. Developers of protein language model applications may be interested in the training-free retrieval design as a baseline or alternative to fine-tuned approaches. Major strengths The training-free design is a practical advantage, as it avoids the need for task-specific fine-tuning and may generalize across diverse binding site types. The use of exhaustive MaxSim without pooling or approximate nearest-neighbor search is methodologically transparent and avoids approximation artifacts. The reported scale of analysis, covering 37,682 proteins and 153,805 cavities, suggests a serious computational effort. The open-source and web server availability is a positive step for reproducibility and community adoption. Major Concerns Concern ID R1-M1 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Evidence sufficiency Claim pointer The claim that PocketScope "ranks 1st of 23 methods by mean rank across the ten collections" on the ProSPECCTs benchmark. Evidence pointer Abstract only, location not provided Concern The abstract provides no statistical context for this ranking. There is no information on the distribution of ranks across the ten collections, the magnitude of differences between PocketScope and the second-ranked method, or whether the ranking is based on statistically significant improvements. Without these details, the "1st of 23" claim cannot be interpreted as a meaningful advantage. Why it matters A top rank on a benchmark is only meaningful if the margin is substantial and consistent. If PocketScope ranks first by a narrow margin or performs poorly on several collections, the claim of superiority is misleading. The absence of per-collection results prevents assessment of robustness. Resolution test Provide per-collection ranks, the mean and median rank with confidence intervals, and a statistical comparison against the second-best method. Report whether the ranking is stable under variations in the cavity detection step or embedding parameters. Concern ID R1-M2 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Claim substantiation Claim pointer The claim that PocketScope "recovered documented drug off-targets across a curated set of pharmacological pairs." Evidence pointer Abstract only, location not provided Concern The abstract does not specify the size of the curated set, the source of the off-target annotations, the retrieval threshold used to define "recovery," or the success rate. Without these details, it is impossible to determine whether the recovery rate is high, moderate, or trivially low. The term "curated" implies manual selection, which raises the risk of selection bias. Why it matters Off-target prediction is the stated practical application. If the recovery rate is low or the curated set is small or biased, the claim of practical utility is weakened. The absence of a comparison to baseline methods for this specific task further limits interpretation. Resolution test Report the number of pharmacological pairs, the source of annotations, the recovery rate with a clear definition of success, and a comparison to a simple sequence-similarity baseline or a random expectation. Provide the full list of pairs and retrieval scores in supplementary materials. Concern ID R1-M3 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Methodological transparency Claim pointer The claim that PocketScope "represents cavity-lining residues using frozen ESM-C 600M embeddings" and "retrieves related binding sites through exhaustive late-interaction MaxSim." Evidence pointer Abstract only, location not provided Concern The abstract does not describe how cavities are detected, how cavity-lining residues are defined, how the MaxSim score is computed across cavities of different sizes, or how the final retrieval ranking is generated. The choice of ESM-C 600M over other model sizes or architectures is not justified. The computational cost of exhaustive MaxSim at proteome scale is not reported. Why it matters Reproducibility and scalability are central to the claimed practical utility. Without details on cavity detection and scoring, other groups cannot replicate the method. If the computational cost is prohibitive, the "practical framework" claim is undermined. Resolution test Provide a detailed methods section describing cavity detection, residue selection, embedding extraction, MaxSim computation, and ranking. Report runtime and memory requirements for the full proteome scan. Justify the choice of ESM-C 600M with a comparison to alternative models. Concern ID R1-M4 Severity Major Blocking No Axis Comparative validity Claim pointer The claim that PocketScope "ranks 1st of 23 methods" implies superiority over existing approaches. Evidence pointer Abstract only, location not provided Concern The abstract does not describe the 22 other methods in the ProSPECCTs benchmark, whether they are training-free or trained, or whether the comparison is apples-to-apples. If the other methods use different cavity definitions or different input features, the ranking may reflect benchmark design rather than method quality. Why it matters A benchmark ranking is only informative if the comparison is fair and the methods are described. Without this context, the "1st of 23" claim is difficult to interpret. Resolution test List the 22 other methods with their type (training-free vs. trained), input features, and any benchmark-specific constraints. Discuss potential sources of bias in the comparison. Minor Comments Concern ID R1-m1 Severity Minor Axis Clarity Affected element Abstract wording Evidence pointer Abstract, "training-free framework" and "exhaustive late-interaction MaxSim" Issue The term "training-free" is used but not defined. It is unclear whether this means no fine-tuning of ESM-C, no training of any new parameters, or no supervised training at all. The term "late-interaction" is a technical term that may not be familiar to all readers. Required correction Define "training-free" explicitly in the abstract or methods. Add a brief explanation of "late-interaction" or replace with a more accessible term. Concern ID R1-m2 Severity Minor Axis Completeness Affected element Benchmark description Evidence pointer Abstract, "ProSPECCTs benchmark" Issue The abstract does not state what the ProSPECCTs benchmark measures, how many queries are in each collection, or what the evaluation metric is beyond "mean rank." Required correction Add one sentence describing the benchmark and the evaluation metric. Specify the number of collections and queries. Concern ID R1-m3 Severity Minor Axis Reproducibility Affected element Web server and code availability Evidence pointer Abstract, "open source and also freely available as a web server" Issue The abstract states availability but does not specify the license, the programming language, or the dependencies. The URL is provided but no version or release date is given. Required correction Provide a license, a version number, and a brief description of the implementation in the abstract or a data availability statement. Concern ID R1-m4 Severity Minor Axis Interpretation Affected element Proteome-scale results Evidence pointer Abstract, "identified 153,805 cavities across 37,682 proteins" Issue The abstract does not state how many of these cavities are predicted to be binding sites versus merely detected as pockets. The number of cavities per protein varies widely, and the abstract does not indicate whether this distribution is biologically plausible. Required correction Clarify whether all detected cavities are considered binding sites or whether a filtering step is applied. Report the distribution of cavities per protein. Risk / unsupported claims The "1st of 23 methods" ranking is unsupported without per-collection results and statistical context. The "recovered documented drug off-targets" claim is unsupported without the size of the curated set, the recovery rate, and the definition of recovery. The "practical framework" claim is unsupported without computational cost and runtime data. The biological significance of identifying 153,805 cavities is not interpretable without a comparison to expected numbers or a functional annotation analysis. The generalizability of the training-free approach beyond the tested benchmark is not assessable from the abstract. The claim that ESM-C 600M embeddings are appropriate for this task is not justified with comparative data.

本文系统评估了残基级粗粒化（CG）模型在模拟IDP凝聚物时，能否同时再现平衡性质（相图、链尺寸）和动力学性质（链重排时间、扩散系数）。核心发现是CG模型能准确再现平衡性质，但动力学时间重标度因子是系统依赖的（随分子环境、序列组成、甚至观测量的不同而变化），且与链间相互作用能强相关。该工作为使用CG模拟研究IDP凝聚物动力学提供了关键的校准原则和局限性分析，对AI辅助力场开发和动力学预测有重要指导意义。 02 一句话总结 本文通过对比四种不同阳离子伴侣与阴离子IDP ProTα形成的复杂凝聚物的CG模拟与实验数据，发现残基级CG模型能准确再现平衡相行为和链尺寸，但动力学时间重标度因子在稀相与浓相之间、不同凝聚物组成之间不可转移，且与链的总非键相互作用能强相关。 03 研究问题 具体问题 : 残基级隐式溶剂粗粒化（CG）模型在模拟IDP凝聚物时，能否在准确再现平衡性质（相图、链尺寸）的同时，也以可转移的时间重标度因子再现分子动力学（链重排时间、扩散系数）？ 为什么重要 : CG模拟是研究IDP凝聚物大尺度、长时间行为的关键工具。如果动力学时间重标度不可转移，那么从CG模拟中直接解读的链松弛、扩散、材料性质（如粘度）将产生系统性偏差，需要额外的动力学校准。 现有方法为何不足 : 现有CG模型通常仅用平衡性质（如相图、FRET效率）进行参数化和验证，隐含假设了动力学时间重标度是全局可转移的。本文直接挑战了这一假设。 精确的「Can ... ?」研究问题 : Can a residue-level CG model, parameterized using equilibrium observables, preserve a transferable timescale for conformational dynamics across different molecular environments (dilute vs. dense phase) and condensate compositions (different cationic partners)? 04 背景与发展脉络 阶段1: 全原子（AA）MD模拟IDP凝聚物 : 能提供原子级分辨率，但受限于时间和空间尺度，难以直接模拟相平衡。 阶段2: 残基级隐式溶剂CG模拟 : 通过减少自由度，能模拟更大体系（如凝聚物）和更长时间尺度。代表性模型包括HPS (Ashbaugh-Hatch)、Mpipi-Recharged等。优点：能有效再现IDP的构象系综和相图（临界温度、相密度）。局限：通常使用弱摩擦Langevin动力学（γ≈0.2 ps⁻¹）加速采样，导致绝对时间尺度失真，需要经验性时间重标度。 本文主张的位置 : 本文系统性地检验了CG模拟中动力学时间重标度的可转移性。它指出，仅凭平衡性质验证不足以保证动力学准确性。时间重标度因子是系统依赖的，与分子环境、序列组成和观测量有关，且与链的总非键相互作用能相关。这为CG模拟在凝聚物动力学研究中的应用设定了明确的边界条件。 脉络来源 : 经外部核验（基于文中引用的文献[10-16, 30-35, 40-43]）。 05 核心痛点 痛点 表现 成因或作者解释 文中证据 动力学时间重标度不可转移 从稀相单体到二聚体到浓相，所需的时间重标因子（S_t）相差一个数量级（30 vs. 170 vs. 300）。不同凝聚物（如H1-ProTα vs. protamine-ProTα）的S_t也不同。 presented in the manuscript Shared manuscript claim summary The authors test whether a residue-level coarse-grained (CG) model that reproduces equilibrium phase behavior of complex coacervates also preserves a transferable timescale for conformational dynamics. They find that time rescaling is not transferable between dense and dilute phases, across condensate compositions, or between different dynamical observables, and that the required rescaling correlates with the total non-bonded interaction energy of the protein chains. S1–S2) Missing materials affecting confidence Supplementary figures S1 and S2 are referenced but not provided in the submitted material. The raw simulation trajectories, force field parameter files, and analysis scripts are not provided. Experimental data used for comparison are cited but not included. Reviewer Overall assessment This manuscript presents a systematic and well-motivated investigation of the limitations of time rescaling in residue-level coarse-grained simulations of biomolecular condensates. The authors demonstrate that while the HPS CG model reproduces equilibrium properties (dense-phase concentrations, chain dimensions, FRET efficiencies) across four complex coacervate systems, the dynamical time rescaling required to match experimental reconfiguration times is system-dependent, environment-dependent, and potentially observable-dependent. The correlation between the time-rescaling factor and the total non-bonded interaction energy provides a physically plausible explanation. The work is timely and addresses an important gap in the field, as most CG condensate studies focus on equilibrium validation without critically examining dynamical fidelity. However, several technical aspects require clarification or additional analysis before the central claims can be fully established. Who would be interested in the results, and why Researchers in computational biophysics, particularly those developing or using coarse-grained models for intrinsically disordered proteins and biomolecular condensates. The findings are also relevant to experimentalists using single-molecule FRET and fluorescence correlation spectroscopy to study condensate dynamics, as the work provides a framework for interpreting CG simulation timescales. The conceptual connection to polymer physics and generalized Langevin dynamics will interest theorists working on coarse-graining methodologies. Major strengths 1. The study addresses a critical and underappreciated issue: whether equilibrium validation of CG models implies dynamical accuracy. 2. The experimental comparison is comprehensive, covering four condensate systems with distinct cationic partners, multiple ionic strengths, and two dynamical observables (reconfiguration time and diffusion coefficient). 3. The systematic variation of the Langevin friction coefficient over five orders of magnitude is a rigorous test of whether a single friction parameter can resolve the non-transferability. 4. The correlation between time-rescaling factors and interaction energies provides a physically interpretable, potentially predictive relationship. Major Concerns R1-M1, R1-M2, R1-M3, R1-M4 Minor Comments R1-m1, R1-m2, R1-m3, R1-m4 Technical failings that need to be addressed before the case is established R1-M1, R1-M2, R1-M3 Assessment against Nature-style criteria Originality: High. While the general idea that CG models require time rescaling is known, the systematic demonstration across multiple condensate systems and the correlation with interaction energy are novel. Scientific importance: High. The work directly challenges the common practice of applying a single global time-rescaling factor in CG condensate simulations and provides a framework for more rigorous dynamical interpretation. Interdisciplinary readership: Moderate. The manuscript is written for a specialized biophysics audience; the conceptual framework connecting to polymer physics and generalized Langevin dynamics broadens its appeal. Technical soundness: Moderate. The simulation methodology is appropriate, but several technical concerns (friction coefficient choice, diffusion analysis, dilute-phase statistics) require clarification. Readability for nonspecialists: Moderate. The introduction and conclusions are accessible, but the methods and results sections assume familiarity with CG simulation techniques and Langevin dynamics. Recommendation posture Supportive if technical concerns are resolved Major Concerns Concern ID R1-M1 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Methodology / Data analysis Claim pointer The authors claim that the time-rescaling factor for chain reconfiguration is not transferable between dense and dilute phases, across condensate compositions, and may be observable-dependent. Evidence pointer Section III.D, Figures 4 and 5 Concern The time-rescaling factors are calculated using a single Langevin friction coefficient of γ = 0.2 ps⁻¹, which the authors acknowledge is far from the physically motivated Stokes estimate of ~30 ps⁻¹. While the authors test the dependence on γ (Figure 5), the production simulations use γ = 0.2 ps⁻¹. The choice of this specific value is justified only by common usage in the field ("to accelerate sampling and improve sampling efficiency"). The authors show that varying γ does not eliminate system-dependent differences in time rescaling, but the absolute values of the rescaling factors and their ratios depend on γ. The claim of non-transferability is robust, but the quantitative rescaling factors reported (30, 170, 300 for monomer, dimer, dense phase) are specific to this friction coefficient and may not be directly comparable to other CG studies using different γ values. Why it matters The quantitative rescaling factors are the primary output of the dynamical analysis. If these values are artifacts of the chosen friction coefficient, their physical interpretation (e.g., the correlation with interaction energy in Figure 5f) may be compromised. The field needs guidance on whether rescaling factors from different CG studies are comparable. Resolution test The authors should provide a clear statement that the rescaling factors are conditional on γ = 0.2 ps⁻¹. They should also show, perhaps in a supplementary figure, how the rescaling factors for all four condensates and the dilute-phase systems vary with γ, not just the H1–ProTα system shown in Figure 5d–e. This would demonstrate whether the relative ordering of rescaling factors (e.g., protamine > H1) is robust across friction coefficients. Concern ID R1-M2 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Data analysis / Statistical rigor Claim pointer The authors claim that the time-rescaling factors inferred from diffusion coefficients are approximately 1.5- to 5-fold smaller than those from reconfiguration times, suggesting possible observable dependence. Evidence pointer Section III.D, Figure S2 (not provided) Concern The diffusion coefficient analysis is described only briefly, and the key evidence (Figure S2) is not provided in the submitted material. The authors acknowledge substantial statistical and systematic uncertainties in the diffusion estimates, including chain-to-chain variation, finite-size effects, and slab geometry artifacts. Without seeing the actual data, it is impossible to assess whether the observed discrepancy between rescaling factors from reconfiguration and diffusion is statistically significant or within the noise. The authors themselves state that "the present data do not allow us to unequivocally attribute the discrepancy to the intrinsic observable dependence." This claim is therefore currently unsupported. Why it matters The claim of observable-dependent time rescaling is a significant finding with implications for how CG simulations should be calibrated. If this claim is not robust, the paper's conclusions should be tempered accordingly. Resolution test Provide Figure S2 and a more detailed analysis of the diffusion coefficient uncertainties. The authors should perform a statistical test (e.g., a bootstrap or jackknife analysis across chains) to determine whether the rescaling factors from reconfiguration and diffusion are significantly different for each condensate. If the uncertainties are too large to draw conclusions, this should be stated explicitly and the claim of observable dependence should be downgraded to a speculation. Concern ID R1-M3 Severity Major Blocking Yes Axis Methodology / Validation Claim pointer The authors claim that the CG simulations reproduce experimentally measured FRET efficiencies for ProTα in the dense phase. Evidence pointer Section III.C, Figure 3c–f Concern The dense-phase FRET efficiencies are calculated using an implicit-dye approximation (scaling the Cα distance by a factor based on sequence separation). The authors validate this approximation with a single explicit-dye simulation for the H1–ProTα condensate at one ionic strength (Figure 3c). However, the implicit-dye approximation is used for all other dense-phase systems and ionic strengths. The validation is insufficient: (1) only one condensate composition is tested; (2) only one ionic strength is tested; (3) the agreement between implicit and explicit methods is shown as a single data point, not a statistical comparison. The implicit-dye approximation may introduce systematic errors that vary with condensate composition or ionic strength, potentially affecting the comparison with experimental FRET data. Why it matters The FRET efficiency comparison is a key validation of the CG model's equilibrium conformational ensembles. If the implicit-dye approximation introduces systematic errors, the conclusion that the CG model reproduces experimental chain dimensions in the dense phase may be weakened. Resolution test Perform explicit-dye simulations for at least one additional condensate (e.g., protamine–ProTα) at one ionic strength to demonstrate that the implicit approximation holds across compositions. Alternatively, provide a more rigorous justification for the scaling factor used in the implicit approximation, including error estimates from the explicit-dye simulation. Concern ID R1-M4 Severity Major Blocking No Axis Interpretation / Generalizability Claim pointer The authors claim that the correlation between the time-rescaling factor and the total non-bonded interaction energy (Figure 5f) suggests that missing frictional effects arise from protein-protein interactions rather than solely from protein-solvent interactions. Evidence pointer Section III.D, Figure 5f Concern The correlation in Figure 5f is based on only six data points (monomer, dimer, and four condensates). The approximately linear relationship on a log-linear scale is suggestive but not statistically robust. The authors interpret this correlation within a Kramers-like barrier-crossing picture, but they acknowledge that ⟨E_int⟩ is an equilibrium interaction energy, not an activation free energy. The mechanistic link between the total interaction energy and the effective friction from missing degrees of freedom is not established. The correlation could be coincidental or driven by a third variable (e.g., chain density, which correlates with both interaction energy and dynamics). Why it matters The correlation is presented as a key finding that provides a physical explanation for the system-dependent time rescaling. If the correlation is weak or confounded, the mechanistic interpretation is speculative. Resolution test The authors should (1) report the correlation coefficient and p-value for the relationship in Figure 5f; (2) test whether the correlation persists when controlling for dense-phase concentration or chain density; (3) discuss alternative interpretations, such as the possibility that the correlation reflects the density-dependence of friction rather than a direct energetic effect. Minor Comments Concern ID R1-m1 Severity Minor Axis Clarity / Presentation Affected element Section III.D, Figure 4a Evidence pointer Location not provided Issue The time-rescaling factors for monomeric ProTα (30), H1–ProTα dimer (170), and dense phase (300) are reported in the text but are not labeled directly on Figure 4a. The figure shows the reconfiguration times, not the rescaling factors. Required correction Add the rescaling factor values to the figure or figure legend, or provide a separate panel showing the rescaling factors explicitly. Concern ID R1-m2 Severity Minor Axis Methodology / Reporting Affected element Section II (Models and Methods) Evidence pointer Location not provided Issue The method for calculating the chain reconfiguration time (τ_r) from the distance correlation function is described only by reference to equations 7-9, but these equations are not explicitly shown in the manuscript. The reader must infer the exact definition from the text. Required correction Include the explicit equations for the distance correlation function and the fitting procedure used to extract τ_r, either in the main text or in a supplementary methods section. Concern ID R1-m3 Severity Minor Axis Data presentation Affected element Section III.B, Figure 2 Evidence pointer Location not provided Issue The dilute-phase concentrations are reported with large uncertainties, and the authors state that the uncertainty ranges "generally encompassed the corresponding experimental dilute-phase concentrations." However, the figure does not show the experimental dilute-phase concentrations for comparison, only the simulated values. Required correction Add the experimental dilute-phase concentration data to Figure 2c–f, or provide a supplementary table comparing simulated and experimental values. Concern ID R1-m4 Severity Minor Axis Clarity / Terminology Affected element Section IV (Conclusions) Evidence pointer Location not provided Issue The phrase "analssogous coarse-graining" appears to be a typographical error. Required correction Correct to "analogous coarse-graining." Risk / unsupported claims The claim of observable-dependent time rescaling (reconfiguration vs. diffusion) is unsupported because the key evidence (Figure S2) is not provided and the authors acknowledge large uncertainties. The claim that the correlation between time-rescaling factor and interaction energy (Figure 5f) implies that missing frictional effects arise from protein-protein interactions is plausible but not rigorously established; alternative interpretations (e.g., density-dependent friction) are not ruled out. The claim that the CG simulations reproduce dilute-phase concentrations is weakly supported due to large statistical uncertainties; the statement that uncertainty ranges "generally encompassed" experimental values is qualitative.

Reviewer Overall assessment This manuscript presents an ambitious theoretical framework that attempts to integrate multiple biophysical and systems biology concepts to describe epichaperome function. While the scope is broad and the conceptual synthesis is interesting, the manuscript in its current form is a qualitative proposal without any mathematical implementation, computational modeling, or experimental validation. The claims are speculative and the evidence base is insufficient to establish the proposed theory as a testable scientific framework. Who would be interested in the results, and why Researchers in chaperone biology, stress response, and protein homeostasis may find the conceptual framework thought-provoking as a potential new way to think about epichaperome organization. Biophysicists and systems biologists interested in active matter and nonequilibrium systems might also be intrigued by the proposed integration of theories. Major strengths The manuscript attempts to bridge multiple disciplines (electrostatics, transport theory, active matter, percolation theory, graph theory, condensate thermodynamics) to provide a unified view of epichaperome function.
